content.value: A thin-wall cylindrical casting of 100mm inside diameter, 10mm thickness and 250mm length is to be cast using cast iron in greensand mould. Determine the followings-
i) Using 20% longer than solidification time, calculate the pouring time required for the (05) casting. The mould constant in Chvorinov's rule is 1.2 s/mm².
ii) Using a 50mm high-pouring basin, calculate the effective metal head pressure developed (05) in the gating system. List all assumptions you have made during this calculation.
(iii Calculate the choke area of the gating system. Use 7.0 g/cc for liquid metal density and (05) 0.80 for discharge coefficient.

(iv) Calculate sprue top and bottom areas, runner area and gate area of the gating system. (15) Use critical velocity = 500mm/s for this unpressurised gating system with a gating ratio = 1 : 2 : 4. Also use a safety factor of 25% to oversize the sprue top area.

(Answer ANY TWO questions from this section in answer script B)   
Q
